notes.title: Gameplay fixes and bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Handpose changing while holding an item makes player not able to grab things again
[*] Player can't interact with anything after becoming a fist
[*] Can't move after changing pose and picking up extendable arm
[*] A player attached to the turning key is forced to "die", and therefore respawn in a location other than the turning key.
[*] Plateau of extendable arm rotates to the other player when extending, makes it difficult and sometimes impossible to grab handles and other items in puzzles
[*] multiple gameplay fixes and bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Performance issues should be fixed :)
notes.content:
- Less audio glitches and better performance
- Minor changes

notes.title: Spelling, Softlock lvl 2, Camera issues
notes.content:
Fixed following playtest issues:

General:
- Flower pot without it's own icon in backpack (traffic cone)

Level 1:
- Battery, players could be pushed in wall
- Spawn point lvl 1 part 1 area 4 players could spawn outside of camera view
- Multiple spelling mistakes in Intro cutscene and NPC's

Level 2:
- Softlock p7 waarbij push pull out of reach, it was not pushable because 2 players were needed, it is now one handle
- Multiple camera issues
- Better dithering P7
- Multiple platforming issues

Level 3:
- Conveyor P3 delayed event activation
- Dither tunnel P7
- Coins without dropshadow P9

Thank you for finding these issues!
